caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden stool with a curved X-shaped frame and a rectangular cushioned seat. The legs and frame of the stool are brown with a reddish hue and appear to be made of polished wood, featuring circular and cylindrical carved details, especially at the crossing point and horizontal stretcher. The seat cushion is black or dark gray in color, with a slight sheen suggesting a smooth, upholstered fabric. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition. The stool is centered in the drawing, and the lighting creates soft shadows beneath and behind it.
title: Stool
